name: Princess Memory
source:
In the sunny world of Eden, there is a cave that is always changing and full of monsters. Our protagonist finds a girl named Felia, who lost both her memories and her ‘heart’. He helps her to regain her memories and form.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/01/april-2000-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在阳光明媚的伊甸世界，有一座不断变化、遍布怪物的洞窟。主人公发现了名叫菲莉娅的少女，她失去了记忆，也失去了“心”。他帮助她找回记忆和形体。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/01/april-2000-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
